{{Quote|Don't even ask what they do up there. They keep apart. They come and go, but they're there when we need them to fight, so no questions asked. Fair bit of Fett clone blood up there, because the place was a haven for deserters during the wars.|[[Goran Beviin]]|<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>}}
'''Kyrimorut''' was a remote bastion and stronghold located in the northern hemisphere of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. A large example of the traditional [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] dwelling known as a ''[[Vheh'yaim/Legends|vheh'yaim]]'', Kyrimorut served as the home of the Mandalorian [[Clan Skirata|Skirata clan]], as well as a refuge for any [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] or [[Clone commando/Legends|commando]] who wished to desert the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the start of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Jedi purge]] beginning with the issuance of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], Kyrimorut accepted [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] deserters from the new [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], as well as a small number of refugee [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who sought to escape the Empire's persecution.

==Description==
{{Quote|He'll love thrashing that up and down the lake at Kyrimorut.|[[Kal Skirata]], referring to his adopted son [[Mereel Skirata|Mereel]]|<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Vhehyaim-Insider86.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Mandalorian ''[[Vheh'yaim/Legends|vheh'yaim]]'', of which Kyrimorut was a large example]]
Located in the dense [[veshok]] forests of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] northern hemisphere, Kyrimorut was fringed by [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and sat near a wide lake. The nearest settlement to Kyrimorut was [[Enceri]], a relatively small trading post town.<ref name="O66" /> The compound's main building was a large ''[[Vheh'yaim/Legends|vheh'yaim]]'': circular, partially submerged in the ground, and possessing a [[Grass/Legends|grass]] roof that camouflaged it from the air. It had narrow, slit-like [[Window/Legends|windows]] with [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] panes, and the floor was constructed using [[Wood/Legends|wood]] paneling. An emergency trapdoor was installed in the floor, covered over with [[Rope/Legends|rope]]-like matting, which led down into a series of tunnels connecting the main building with a number of nearby [[Fortress/Legends|redoubts]]. The large central room—known as the ''karyai'' in [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']], meaning "main living room"—was connected to a number of adjacent other rooms that ran around it like spokes around the hub of a wheel.<ref name="TC" />

Among Kyrimorut's more notable features was an [[Armory/Legends|armory]], a fully stocked kitchen and a large [[Foodstuff/Legends|dining]] area, a moderately equipped medical research [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] with equipment used for studying [[DNA/Legends|genetics]],<ref name="TC" /> and a small medical facility maintained by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Mij Gilamar]], and furnished with equipment Gilamar had stolen from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenters]]. Designed to be secluded and hidden, Kyrimorut also possessed a covered [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] to discreetly store [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="O66" /> The homestead was mostly self-sufficient, growing much of its own food, and raising both [[Nuna/Legends|nunas]] and [[Roba/Legends|roba]] for later consumption. However, in the early weeks of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] reign, Kyrimorut's reserves were not enough to sustain its significant population, and the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|purchase]] of outside supplies was a necessity.<ref name="ImpCom501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

In [[Time/Legends|time]], a memorial to fallen [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] was erected at Kyrimorut, marked with an inscription that in ''Mando'a'' read: ''Rejorhaa'ruetiise meg'oyacyi jorcu mhi r'asham''—"Tell the ''aruetiise'' that they lived because we died."<ref name="O66" />

==History==
{{Quote|I never fit in.''"<br />"''Not even at Kyrimorut?''"<br />"''That's different. It's Misfit Central.|[[Ruusaan Skirata]] and [[Bardan Jusik]]|<ref name="ImpCom501st" />}}
Construction on Kyrimorut began around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], on land in Mandalore's northern hemisphere owned by the veteran Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], [[Kal Skirata]]. Due to his commitments to the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], Skirata entrusted the oversight of Kyrimorut's construction to his long-time friend and colleague, [[Rav Bralor]], whom he had spent nearly a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] with on the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], training [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] for the Republic's [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Army/Legends|army]] as members of the ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]''. Bralor commanded a team of skilled construction [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the creation of the sprawling ''vheh'yaim'', and finally turned the property over into Skirata's possession later that year.<ref name="TC" />

After kidnapping the rogue [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]], [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]], Skirata brought the captive Kaminoan to his home on Mandalore. At Kyrimorut, he kept Ko Sai imprisoned in an effort to force her to create a cure that would halt the accelerated aging that plagued the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and artificially shortened their lifespans, until the Kaminoan scientist [[Death/Legends|took her own life]] to spite Skirata.

[[File:KaminoRecording.jpg|thumb|left|275px|[[Clan Skirata]], the primary residents of Kyrimorut]]
With construction on the compound complete, Kyrimorut became the full time home of [[Clan Skirata]] on Mandalore. When Kal Skirata's former clone trainee [[Fi Skirata|Fi]] was gravely injured during a [[Battle of Gaftikar|mission]] to [[Gaftikar]], he was [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] out of the Grand Army and brought to Kyrimorut to begin a long-term road to recovery.<ref name="TC" /> In the aftermath of the issuance of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], Kyrimorut came to house numerous other clone deserters, including the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]]—whom Skirata had trained and raised as his sons—and the clone commandos [[Corr Skirata|Corr]] and [[Atin Skirata|Atin]] of [[Omega Squad]]. They were joined by [[Besany Wennen]], the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of Null ARC trooper [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]], and Atin's [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] wife, [[Laseema]]. Kal Skirata's biological daughter, [[Ruusaan Skirata|Ruusaan]], and the late [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] sister, [[Arla Fett|Arla]], were also given lodgings at Kyrimorut. In addition, the former [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]] had been brought to Kyrimorut to make up for the loss of Ko Sai, with Uthan persuaded to continue seeking a cure for the clones' accelerated aging.<ref name="O66" />

During the [[Skirmish on Shinarcan Bridge Extension|chaotic events]] on the night of Order 66's enactment, Etain Tur-Mukan was accidentally killed by a panicked [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] when she attempted to stop a confrontation between the Padawan and a clone trooper from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] whom he was attempting to [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|attack]] with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Her son, Venku, was taken safely to Kyrimorut by the Skirata clan; Tur-Mukan's body was later delivered to the Mandalore homestead by a friend of the clan, [[Nyreen Vollen]], where she was [[Funeral of Etain Tur-Mukan|cremated]] in a traditional [[Jedi funeral/Legends|Jedi funeral]] the following day.<ref name="O66" />

As the Republic [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] into the Galactic Empire, under the newly crowned [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Kyrimorut welcomed the former [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] [[Levet (clone)|Levet]] and the commandos of [[Yayax Squad]], after they abandoned their lives in the clone army. In addition to on-the-run clones, at Nyreen Vollen's request, Kyrimorut became a refuge for two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fugitives from the Empire's emerging [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Jedi purge]]: [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]], and a rare Kaminoan [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Kina Ha]].<ref name="O66" /> Several weeks after the Empire's formation, Kal Skirata's daughter Ruusaan and the former Jedi-turned-Mandalorian [[Bardan Jusik]] picked up the [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Maze (clone trooper)|Maze]], when he [[Comlink/Legends|contacted]] the Skirata clan for assistance after deserting. Maze had also rescued Jedi Master [[Arligan Zey]] from death during the events of Order 66, and both were brought to Mandalore and given refuge at Kyrimorut. Due to their close ties to the Skirata clan, the Mandalorians Mij Gilamar, [[Wad'e Tay'haai]], [[Walon Vau]], and Rav Bralor, were all frequent visitors to Kyrimorut.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

Kyrimorut remained a haven for clones and the Skirata clan for years to come, and by [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the residents had colloquially become known as the Kyrimorut "wild men." Among those known to still reside at Kyrimorut by this time were Venku Skirata and Bardan Jusik, the latter going by the adopted name of Gotab.<ref name="Revelation" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kyrimorut first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] in ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'', the third entry in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] of novels, authored by [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[October 30]], [[2007]]. The sequel to ''True Colors'', entitled [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], also featured Kyrimorut as a prominent location, as did the following novel, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''. Traviss later referenced Kyrimorut in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'', her third entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel series.

The name ''Kyrimorut'' appears to be a compound word, specifically from the ''Mando'a'' words ''kyr'', meaning "end", and ''morut'', meaning "haven, stronghold".<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>
